title: Gema Sunyi di Sudut Kamar
theme: Seorang profesional muda menghadapi pergolakan batin berupa overthinking dan kecemasan, mencoba menemukan kedamaian dalam rutinitas malam di kamarnya sendiri.

cover.prompt: An interior shot of a quiet bedroom at late night. A small bedside lamp on a nightstand casts a soft, warm glow across a slightly rumpled bed, creating areas of gentle low illumination in the room. The composition uses the rule of thirds, with a shallow depth of field, focusing on the intimate details of the lamp and the immediate surroundings. The atmosphere evokes a feeling of quiet contemplation and subtle restlessness. No specific person is visible, emphasizing the environment and the tranquil stillness of the late hour. A window subtly suggests a peaceful night outside.
cover.style: Cinematic photography, shallow depth of field, warm color grading

meta.plan_summary: A young professional, Nara, battles nightly anxiety and overthinking, finding peace through mindfulness and embracing internal chaos.
